name: B10-0384/2025 (ECR) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns recent terrorist attacks in Colombia and the assassination of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay. It calls on Colombia to protect political candidates, investigate the attacks and fight impunity. It says President Petro's "total peace" policy failed and let armed groups grow. It asks the EU to add the Cártel de los Soles to its terrorist list, sanction Venezuelan leaders, and support Colombia against drug trafficking. This is a statement of opinion and requests; it does not change any law.

- The EU is asked to label the Cártel de los Soles a terrorist group and sanction Maduro and Cabello.
- Colombia is urged to protect candidates, investigate the attacks and prosecute those responsible.
- The EU and partners should help Colombia fight drug trafficking and organised crime.
